IC1: - Patients admitted to the ICU [AND] who are receiving vasoactive drugs.
IC2: - Age greater than or equal to 18 years old.
IC3: - Expected to remain admitted to the ICU for at least 24 hours post-enrolment.
IC4: - Clinicians who work in the intensive care unit where a patient participant has been admitted.
IC5: - An ICU clinician at the research site.
IC6: - Has used the ICU physical rehabilitation adverse event tool as part of this research study.
